name: Holographic Defuser Light Field Display
aliases: Jones et al. holographic rotating diffuser
definition: A system combining a rotating holographic defuser and a high-speed projector to form multiple viewpoints in 360 degrees. The holographic defuser reflects images within a limited range of 1.25 degrees, updating the image synchronized with rotation to generate viewpoints.
summary: The Holographic Defuser Light Field Display is a volumetric system that generates a 360-degree light field with multiple viewpoints by synchronizing a projector with a rotating holographic defuser, using angular selectivity to spatially multiplex images in free space.
